title: PAC two-act demo production script
status: Implemented guided demonstration — approved sample scenario; browser-local records, not a production service
summary: One fictional Harbor sales story, two independently playable acts, and one Next control. This is a production specification and script review, not a functioning guided demo. Audience interfaces and spoken narration are English.
decisions: Website and Sales Workspace remain independent artifacts. The demo host performs a narrative transition; it never transfers inquiry records, creates an Inbox or connects a CRM.
Customer Proposal is the published customer projection of the Workspace, with PAC customer-facing branding. It is not a third independent quoting system.
Keep the currently approved application direction and official PAC/Annora branding. Withdrawn Website/intake experiments are not visual or implementation baselines.
The standard run uses the product-request Website path. Help me choose is a fixed alternate preset chosen before rehearsal, not an on-stage branch.
Act A ends on the first customer comparison. Act B starts with a question, then investigation, engineering, revision, publication and follow-up.
All new actions and pages described here are production targets. Reuse current business logic where valid, then verify it; do not treat the current screenshot gallery as a live runner.
Trial terms remain two weeks free and paid service only after mutual agreement. The trial sign-off is a deck decision, not a simulated purchase of a PAC machine.
Website inquiry capture is a real local demo save with an explicit demo receipt. It is independent of the prepared sales case and sends nothing externally.

playback.control: Patrick uses Next or Right Arrow. Start applies the first step; each subsequent Next enters the next defined step and performs only its declared action. Speaker notes are separate from product UI.
standardModes: Full run: A01–A24 then B01–B16, then return to the deck before baseline/proof/trial.
Act A only: initialize A-start and stop at A24.
Act B only: initialize the exact published-v1 checkpoint, then start B01.
Help me choose preset: H01–H04 replaces A01–A05, then rejoins A06.
playback.expectedBlocks: A08, A12 and B07 are successful demonstration checkpoints when their specific validation block is visible. Next then enters the scripted resolution. Unexpected errors halt advancement.
onePressContract: Prepare the target page and role, apply the declared action once, verify postconditions, then enable Next.
A step must not bundle configuration, approval and publication into one hidden operation.
No live typing, searching, selecting a record, opening an OS file dialog or responding to a browser print dialog is required.
Repeated clicks while a step runs are ignored. Stable action keys prevent duplicate questions, findings, revisions, replies or publications.
Back or restart restores a demo-only checkpoint; it does not undo or overwrite the existing reviewed Harbor workspace.
Forward replay from a checkpoint reuses or deterministically reconstructs its records. No stale approvals may survive a material change.
All inquiry receipts are idempotent Website-only records. A visible Demo inquiry recorded / Saved in this demonstration label distinguishes local capture from delivery to PAC.
playback.sessionIsolation: Use separate, namespaced demo stores for Website and Workspace plus a host cursor. The host may select the prepared case; it must not import or synchronize Website business records. Leave pac-application-20261108-v1 and all reviewed records untouched. A Website-only demo submission is allowed; it creates a local receipt, not a sales-system record.
checkpointContract: A-start: new Website session; no Workspace session mutated.
website-inquiry-recorded / website-inquiry-help-recorded: independent local Website receipt, no Workspace session mutated.
sales-start: prepared Deal with missing dimensions; no quote/publication.
requirements-confirmed: 12×16 inches and source confirmation; no alternatives yet.
published-v1 / act-a-complete: exact V1 A0/B0, no guide, no C1.
customer-question: V1 plus C1, no revisions or findings.
b-revision-start: V1+C1+F1; B1 copied, no engineering scope.
b-revision-saved: B1 saved at $41,310; no B1 approval.
published-v2: V1+V2 with C1 still unanswered.
act-b-complete: R1 answered; follow-up owned; no acceptance/payment.
playback.refreshAndRecovery: Refresh resumes the last committed step. Failed actions retain the prior checkpoint and offer Retry; no success message before persistence succeeds. A single writer owns the session; other tabs are read-only or explicitly refreshed.
playback.mediaBehavior: Preload approved media and preset views. Next never depends on a third-party player finishing. A failed video shows a labelled still/source fallback; WebGL failure uses actual PAC photos, never a screenshot described as live 3D.
playback.presentationModes: Presenter view shows the spoken line, action and expected result. Audience view shows the product plus a quiet demo indicator; engineering instructions and coverage notes are not customer UI.
playback.sideEffects: No email, CRM write, remote share invitation, signature, payment or production approval is performed. Demo role records are explicit and do not imply live authentication.
playback.deckPlacement: Insert after the AI-search evidence. In a full run, skip duplicate static app screenshots and return before baseline, related customer results, trial acceptance and trial sign-off. A split run pauses on A24, introduces the customer question, then starts B01. Exact host routes are assigned only during approved production.
playback.audienceCopy: Keep commercial uncertainty beside the relevant price, timing or application decision. Put implementation status, source limitations and rehearsal instructions in presenter/production notes rather than repeating them as large audience-facing warnings.
playback.chapterEnd: Keep Next as the single advance control. A24 proceeds to B01 in Full run; in Act A only it returns to the preselected pitch continuation. B16 returns to the preselected baseline/proof/trial pitch continuation on the next press. Choose mode and return anchor before rehearsal; no on-stage menu or routing decision.
playback.deckReturnTalkTrack: You have seen the two sides of the sales experience. The trial is where we check this with PAC’s agreed machines, cases and team: validate the outputs, record the gaps, and compare the work with your baseline. We then review the results together before agreeing any paid continuation.

productionGates.title: Approve the two-act script
productionGates.criterion: Kyle confirms the mainline, alternate preset, fixed business data and boundaries before artifact production begins.

productionGates.title: Verify model and configuration media
productionGates.criterion: Record each exact file, official source, model/option coverage, usage basis, selected video range and fallback. No incorrect equipment imagery, invented guide geometry or generic CAD substitute. Missing matching evidence remains an open acceptance item.

productionGates.title: Keep sample inputs distinct from PAC facts
productionGates.criterion: Dated 2025 prices, illustrative six-week base lead time and $500/+1-week engineering scenario are labelled consistently across builder, review, web proposal and PDF. Replace only with PAC-confirmed inputs when supplied.

productionGates.title: Complete the required business behaviors
productionGates.criterion: Required-information gate; engineering hours/rate/materials; clear pending state; reviewer/revision attribution; immutable publications/resources; contextual replies; explicit next action. Do not force every requirement into the mainline or label partial coverage complete.

productionGates.title: Finish every visible page and state
productionGates.criterion: Homepage, product detail, inquiry and summary; Deal, requirements, builder, validation states, engineering, review, publication; customer application, media, comparison, documents, questions and history. Approved PAC brand family, aligned typography, exact media and stable loading/error/focus states throughout.

productionGates.title: Make the sequence deterministic
productionGates.criterion: Fresh browser, full run, each act independently, alternate Website preset, repeated Next, back/replay, refresh, media failure and paused exploration all reach the documented state without touching reviewed records.

productionGates.title: Accept the delivered demonstration honestly
productionGates.criterion: Record which behaviors are real local operations, prepared demo states, design-only future states and live services. Verify the actual sharing environment and data availability before calling a link a remotely usable app.

acceptance: A fresh browser can complete the full standard run with Next only; no manual field entry or hidden setup is required.
Act A and Act B each start from their documented checkpoint and produce the same meaningful result as the combined run.
Website and Workspace remain independent; no inquiry IDs or records cross their business-state boundary.
Both Website entry presets preserve contact, application and selected-or-unknown product context in one idempotent local demo receipt; the receipt never claims an external send.
Every quoted amount and revision in the version ledger matches builder, review, Proposal and its version-bound PDF.
Unknown required facts and engineering values create the documented blocked state; they are not substituted with zero or a guessed fact.
A material quote change invalidates relevant approval; unchanged A0 remains intact when only B is revised.
Publishing V2 does not alter V1, answer C1, mark the Deal won or initiate an external action.
Customer views exclude internal costs, estimates, private findings, approval controls and draft information.
Every image and video matches its declared model/option scope; absent approved CAD never becomes a geometric claim.
Each visible page, modal, validation message, saved state and media fallback passes visual review at the agreed presentation size and a narrow viewport.
Pause, retry, refresh and repeated Next cannot create duplicate publications, comments or revisions or overwrite the reviewed workspace.
The spoken English explains the actual visible state, uses no unsupported conversion/revenue claims and fits the rehearsal timing.
